title: Gno Meter Basileia
subtitle: From your situation to a considered action
offline: Saved on this device; sync will resume when connected
error: Could not save or load your records. Your input remains in this window.
conflict: There are changes from another device. Both versions will be kept as separate records.
noDraw: First save a nine-card spread in Stoicheion.
intro: Choose a matching situation, or open “Sector themes” to choose any of the 54 themes. Confirm only what fits your case.
goal: What would you like to change?
people: Who is involved? A role is enough; no name needed
object: Which specific subject, conversation or habit will the action address?
criterion: What observable sign will tell you things have improved?
deadline: When will you check the result?
blocker: What is the main obstacle now?
minutes: How many minutes can you actually give one step?
required: Enter a goal, a specific episode, the subject of the action, a result criterion and a review date.
domainPrompts: Which conversation or action changed the closeness between you?
Which specific responsibility or need for care went unanswered?
What change in sleep, energy or wellbeing did you notice, and when?
What in your space or routine makes the day difficult?
Which task or skill have you got stuck on?
Which idea or part of a creative piece are you struggling to express?
Which payment, expense or missing resource needs a decision?
In which meeting, request or shared agreement did the difficulty arise?
Which event made you question a value or your direction in life?
What is preventing a specific break, hobby or trip?
Which real options for change are you choosing between?
In which task, role or agreement did the obstacle arise?
Describe one instance: what happened, who was involved and what would you like to change?
chooseSupport: Choose another card as a possible source of support
reading: Interpretation of the Order of Aurora
projectionHelp: The external sectors come from the method’s table. A source below supports the stated myth, not the entire table of correspondences.
resourceQuestion: Where does this source of support already appear in your life? Can you give a specific example?
bridgeQuestion: Can this support help with the episode you described? Explain how you would apply it.
resourceUnknown: There is no confirmed support yet. You can choose a step that relies only on your current capabilities.
myth: Myth and conditions for the link
noMyth: The reviewed catalogue has no direct myth for this pair. Your experience may support the connection, but it should not be attributed to an ancient source.
interpretation: Method of the Order of Aurora
symbolicNote: The number describes symbolic correspondence, not the probability of an event or a person's strength.
identityNote: This is the same function in two models. The sums necessarily match; this is not additional evidence.
mathHelp: The tetractys weights symbolic fit, resources, context and robustness at 1:2:3:4. The golden ratio balances fit with diversity. Reorderings of independent actions are grouped into one route; required agreement and review retain their order.
evidence: What is your answer based on?
control: Can you change at least part of “{object}” yourself, without someone else's permission?
contact: Is there a suitable and safe way to contact “{people}” about this?
consent: Have the participants “{people}” already agreed to do something together about “{object}”?
access: Do you currently have access to the materials, place or information needed for “{object}”?
reversible: Can you try a small change to “{object}” and undo it without significant loss?
energy: Do you have enough energy for the selected {minutes} minutes without sacrificing necessary rest?
repeat: Have you already repeated the same approach to “{object}” in similar conditions without the result you need?
answered: Your answers are saved. You can compare options.
optionsHelp: These are alternatives: choose one step. Their time costs are not added as though every option had already been carried out.
noOptions: No step fits the time currently available. Adjust the constraint or leave the situation for observation.
fit: This approach fits the obstacle and conditions you described.
alternative: This offers another way forward with less reliance on repeating an earlier attempt.
fallback: If the step does not work
fallbackText: Do not repeat it automatically. Record which condition was unmet and choose another approach at the next review.
actionBodies: For “{object}”, write down one observable event from “{episode}” and one assumption separately. Choose how you will check the assumption.
Name two available options for “{object}”. Compare them against “{criterion}”, their costs and reversibility. Set aside any option that violates your constraint.
Choose the smallest reversible part of “{object}”. Try it within {minutes} minutes. Record any change against “{criterion}”; stop if things worsen.
For “{object}”, prepare one material, space or source you already have access to. Name the exact next step it enables; do not spend new funds without a separate decision.
Draft one question for “{people}” about the obstacle in “{object}”. State what answer you need to decide. Use a suitable channel and allow for refusal or no response.
Propose one mutual step to “{people}” about “{object}”: who will do what, when and how much. Carry out the shared part only after explicit agreement.
Name which part of “{object}” you can currently take on and which part you cannot. Change only your own involvement. If a conversation is needed, first check that contact is appropriate and safe.
Free {minutes} minutes from one optional demand connected with “{object}”. Choose an accessible way to rest and note how you feel before and after, without demanding an immediate result.
Choose one part of “{object}” you can do independently in {minutes} minutes. Link it to a specific event in your day and stop when the time is up.
Prepare a description of “{episode}” and a question about “{object}” for a suitable professional or knowledgeable person. Check the consultation terms before making any commitment.
healthNote: For health topics, steps concern observations, routines and seeking help. Cards cannot diagnose conditions or change prescribed treatment.
noPlan: Choose an available step in the previous stage.
startText: Start when the listed conditions are met and the selected time is available.
practiceHelp: You can add a symbolic practice to your action. Practice completion and the external result are recorded separately.
noWord: No suitable word was found this time. Your practical step is still available.
limit: This record has reached its history limit. Create a new situation.
archiveHelp: The earlier route remains available for existing calculations, practices and purchased results.
futureCheck: The review date must be today or later.
noEvidence: A yes or no answer needs a specific example. If you do not have one, choose “Not sure yet”.
supportApplied: Chosen support: {resource}. Your way to apply it: {application}.
numericHelp: E ∈ {0, 1}; R = 1 ⇔ ρ(S₁) = ρ(S₂); D = 2 gcd(S₁,S₂)/(S₁+S₂); N = .55 E + .25 R + .20 D. The number describes symbolic correspondence, not the probability of an event or a person's strength.
